values: 移动一段距离并为周围友军持续回复能量。
Rowan moves for some distance and continuously recovers Energy for nearby allies.
移动至多1格，并在抵达目的地后持续抛洒金币，使周围2格范围内的其他友军回复共250 + 30点能量。
Rowan moves up to 1 tile and throws coins upon reaching the destination, recovering 250 + 30 Energy for surrounding allies within 2 tiles.
布置“生命药剂”为低生命值友军回复生命值。
Rowan places health potions to recover HP for allies with low HP.
战斗开始时，在自己的推车上布置2瓶“生命药剂”。自身周围2格内的其他友军在生命值百分比低于50%时，会自动使用1瓶“生命药剂”并回复其40% + 4%的最大生命值，回复量最高不超过自身800% + 65%攻击力。每个友军每6秒至多使用1瓶“生命药剂”。

Rowan places 2 health potions on his trolley when a battle starts. Allies within 2 tiles with HP ratio below 50% automatically uses a potion to recover 40% + 4% of their max HP by up to 800% + 65% of Rowan's ATK. Each ally can use up to 1 health potion every 6s.
“生命药剂”回复量提升至42% + 4%的最大生命值。
Increases recovery amount to 42% + 4% of allies' max HP.
战斗开始时，在推车上额外布置1瓶“能量药剂”，自身周围2格内的其他友军在能量高于600时，会自动使用“能量药剂”，回复400点能量。
Places an energy potion when a battle starts. When the Energy of an ally within 2 tiles exceeds 600, they automatically use this potion to recover 400 Energy.
“生命药剂”回复量提升至45% + 4%的最大生命值。
Increases recovery amount to 45% + 4% of allies' max HP.
使唤布拉达克一世对一名敌人造成伤害并吸收其能量，或补充一瓶“生命药剂”。
Rowan calls on Bradduck to attack and absorb Energy from an enemy, or replenish a health potion instead.
使唤布拉达克一世攻击一名敌人，造成150% + 20% ATK的伤害，并吸收目标70点能量。
Rowan calls on Bradduck to attack an enemy, dealing 150% + 20% ATK damage and absorbing 70 Energy.
若“生命药剂”消耗完毕，本次“鸭尔兹”不再攻击敌人，而是会使唤布拉达克一世为推车补充1瓶“生命药剂”。每3次“鸭尔兹”中至多有一次触发本效果。

If all health potions have been used up, Bradduck no longer launches attack but instead replenishes Rowan's trolley with a health potion. This effect can be triggered once every 3 times of Quack Waltz.
提高自身急速，布拉达克一世补充“生命药剂”之前进一步提升急速。
Rowan increases his Haste during battle, with an extra Haste bonus before Bradduck replenishes his health potions.
战斗中，自身提高7点急速。且当“鸭尔兹”首次补充“生命药剂”之前，额外提升6点急速。
Rowan increases his Haste by 7 during battle. His Haste is increased by an extra 6 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.
战斗中，自身提高10点急速。且当“鸭尔兹”首次补充“生命药剂”之前，额外提升8点急速。
Rowan increases his Haste by 10 during battle. His Haste is increased by an extra 8 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.
战斗中，自身提高12点急速。且当“鸭尔兹”首次补充“生命药剂”之前，额外提升10点急速。
Rowan increases his Haste by 12 during battle. His Haste is increased by an extra 10 before replenishing his trolley with Quack Waltz for the first time.
布置超级“生命药剂”为友军回复大量生命值并永久提高护甲和魔抗。
Rowan places a super health potion that recovers an ally's HP and permanently increases their Phys DEF and Magic DEF.
每场战斗一次，在售出3瓶“生命药剂”之后，罗万会布置1瓶超级的“生命药剂”。该“生命药剂”回复使用者60%最大生命值，并且永久提升其30%的护甲和魔抗。

After selling 3 health potions, Rowan places a super health potion that recovers 60% of an ally's max HP and permanently increases their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 30%. This effect can only trigger once per battle.
该“生命药剂”回复使用者65%最大生命值，并且永久提升其35%的护甲和魔抗。
Increases the recovery amount of super health potion to 65% of the ally's max HP, permanently increasing their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 35%.
每场战斗1次，布拉达克一世补充“生命药剂”时，变为补充1瓶超级的“生命药剂”。
When Bradduck replenishes the health potions, one turns into a super health potion, triggered 1 time per battle.
该“生命药剂”回复使用者70%最大生命值，并且永久提升其40%的护甲和魔抗。
Increases the recovery amount of super health potion to 70% of the ally's max HP, permanently increasing their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 40%.
技能“妙手摊贩”布置的“生命药剂”数量提升。
Rowan places 1 more health potion using Smart Stall.
技能“妙手摊贩”在战斗开始时布置的“生命药剂”的数量提升1瓶。
Rowan places 1 more health potion when a battle starts using Smart Stall.
罗万将“能量药剂”升级为超级的“能量药剂”，与原“能量药剂”使用方式相同，但补充能量后还会使目标攻击力提升30%，持续6秒。佩吉在场时，额外为她提供一瓶超级的“生命药剂”。

Rowan upgrades his Energy potion into a super Energy potion. It works the same way as the original Energy potion, but upon restoring the target's Energy, it also increases their ATK by 30% for 6s. If Peggy is on the battlefield, Rowan also prepares an additional super health potion for her.
